cohort: Very low birth weight infants born between 2010 and 2019 in Portugal
finding: Cesarean section was associated with a reduced risk of IVH and related complications in very low birth weight infants born before 32 weeks of gestation, but not with cPVL.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a reduced risk of IVH and its complications in preterm VLBW infants < 32 weeks of gestational age.
